title.zh: Anthropic称Claude揭示NIST椭圆曲线种子参数来源
title.en: Anthropic says Claude uncovered origin of NIST elliptic-curve seed parameters

current_state.zh: Anthropic披露，其Claude模型还原了NIST椭圆曲线种子参数可能的生成方式，为一个约25年历史的密码学透明度问题提供了新解释，同时未破解ECDSA，也未揭示新的曲线漏洞。
current_state.en: Anthropic disclosed that its Claude model reconstructed how NIST elliptic-curve seed parameters were likely generated, offering a new explanation for a roughly 25-year-old cryptographic transparency question without breaking ECDSA or revealing a new curve vulnerability.

updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic研究称，Claude确认NIST椭圆曲线种子是以Unix时间戳为种子的lrand48伪随机数生成器的输出，解开了P-192至P-521参数长期未知的起源。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic research reports that Claude identified the NIST elliptic-curve seeds as outputs of the lrand48 PRNG seeded with a Unix timestamp, resolving the long-unknown origin of the P-192 through P-521 parameters.
